intro: Between April 22 and 27, 2026, ESET published 11 articles covering a range of high-severity threats, with GopherWhisper, APT33, and LockBit among the top actors observed. The reports highlighted significant impacts on government, technology, business services, consumer, and energy sectors across Global, Mongolia, Europe, Japan, and the Middle East. Of the 11 articles, seven were rated high severity, two medium, and one informational, reflecting a concentrated period of notable cyber activity.
